snippet.description:
AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY JUST GOT EVEN BIGGER — AND DOCTOR DOOM LOOKS ABSOLUTELY TERRIFYING!

#AvengersDoomsday #DoctorDoom #RobertDowneyJr #D23 #TrailerReaction #MarvelStudios #MCU #FantasticFour #XMen #ReelRejects 

Aaron Alexander & John Humphrey react to the brand-new Avengers: Doomsday trailer revealed at D23, featuring Robert Downey Jr. as Victor von Doom and a massive collision between the Avengers, Fantastic Four, X-Men, Wakandans, and more. Directed by Anthony & Joe Russo, Avengers: Doomsday stars Robert Downey Jr. (Iron Man, Oppenheimer) as Doctor Doom, Pedro Pascal (The Last of Us, The Mandalorian) as Reed Richards / Mister Fantastic, Vanessa Kirby (The Fantastic Four: First Steps, Mission: Impossible – Dead Reckoning) as Sue Storm, Chris Hemsworth (Thor, Extraction) as Thor, Patrick Stewart (X-Men, Star Trek: Picard) as Professor X, and Ian McKellen (The Lord of the Rings, X-Men) as Magneto.

After watching the new D23 footage, Aaron and John break down Doctor Doom’s ominous introduction, his green eyes, ceremonial armor, devastated surroundings, and the trailer’s heavy focus on his history with the Fantastic Four. They react to Reed Richards confronting Doom, the emotional hints surrounding Doom’s tragic past, Thor being blasted away with seemingly little effort, and the sheer power and presence Robert Downey Jr. brings to Marvel’s next major villain.

The conversation also explores the massive scope of Avengers: Doomsday, including appearances from Professor X, Magneto, Gambit, Wakandan heroes, Sentinels, and the larger multiversal conflict bringing multiple Marvel worlds together. Aaron and John discuss how the darker visual language surrounding Doom contrasts with the retro-futuristic world of the Fantastic Four, why the Reed and Doom relationship may provide the emotional core of the movie, and whether Doomsday could ultimately reset the MCU timeline heading into Avengers: Secret Wars.

Letra

Qué tristeza me da saber que si no traes pasta, no te respetan
La puta sociedad se basa en lo que brilla y en lo que aparenta
Puedes ser el más falso, pero si ante las personas traes careta
Todos te creen el cuento, y si eres cagada, nadie se da cuenta
Las buenas amistades se extinguieron junto con los dinosaurios
Y si hablo de lealtad, me refiero a mí 'amá, que nunca me ha fallado
Tengo un amigo leal, que se ganó el lugar, y ahora le llamo hermano
Tal vez no es de mi sangre, pero como si lo fuera se ha portado
Hay que ser selectivo, que no todo mundo trae la misma vibra
Hay gente muy corriente, que nomás se arrima para ver que chinga
Primero piden mano y cuando se la brindas
Quieren mocharte el pie, nada más para ver después como caminas
Las vibras nunca mienten, y el sexto sentido nunca se equivoca
Hay que alejarse más de la gente que tira mierda por la boca
Al que habla por hablar, lo van a castigar, pero esa es otra cosa
Que elija cada quien el problema con el que quiera hacerse bola
Para ver quién es quién se hicieron las caídas y los malos tiempos
Porque bajo presión se hicieron los diamantes de más alto precio
Dinero hay para todos, pero es que no a todos les cae bien un peso
El poder y la fama, cuando no estás preparado, te hacen menso
Y es que a mi corta edad, les puedo asegurar, que ya he visto de todo
Ricos que se hacen pobres, y pobres bien ricos queriéndolo todo
Nadie valora nada, y quieren más billete
Yo le agradezco a Dios que con vida y salud disfruto mi presente

Avengers: Doomsday is an upcoming American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics superhero team the Avengers. Produced by Marvel Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures, it is intended to be the sequel to Avengers: Endgame (2019) and the 39th film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, and written by Michael Waldron, Stephen McFeely, and the writing team of Chris McKenna and Erik Sommers, the film features an ensemble cast led by Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom. In the film, the Avengers, Wakandans, New Avengers, Fantastic Four, and the X-Men converge from different universes to face Doom.

Two new Avengers films, The Kang Dynasty and Secret Wars, were announced in July 2022 as the conclusion of the MCU's Phase Six and "The Multiverse Saga". Jonathan Majors was set to reprise his MCU role as the villain Kang the Conqueror, with Destin Daniel Cretton and Jeff Loveness hired to direct and write The Kang Dynasty, respectively. In November 2023, Cretton departed, Waldron replaced Loveness as writer, and Marvel was considering moving away from the Kang storyline, in part due to Majors's legal issues; Majors was fired the following month. The return of the Russo brothers as directors and McFeely as co-writer, the casting of Downey as new villain Doctor Doom, and the new subtitle Doomsday were all announced in July 2024. The large cast features actors from previous MCU media and 20th Century Fox's X-Men film series, using the idea of colliding universes to bring together actors from different franchises. Filming took place from April to September 2025 at Pinewood Studios in England, with location filming in England and Bahrain.

Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled to be released in the United States on December 18, 2026, as part of Phase Six of the MCU. The sequel, Avengers: Secret Wars, is set to be released on December 17, 2027.

snippet.title: Avengers: Doomsday | Special Look REACTION!
snippet.description: Avengers: Doomsday | Special Look REACTION!The wait is officially over, geeks — Luke and Audrey are reacting to the brand new Avengers: Doomsday Special Look, and it lived up to every ounce of hype! From the second that Doctor Doom silhouette hit the screen, we knew this was going to be a reaction for the ages. This is our first time watching it, completely unfiltered reactions, so buckle up.In this avengers doomsday trailer reaction, we break down every frame of the avengers doomsday official trailer footage — from the return of familiar MCU faces to the first real look at RDJ as Doctor Doom stepping into the Marvel Cinematic Universe in the most unexpected way possible. We talk through the Thor vs Doctor Doom tease, what it means for Captain America, whether Chris Evans is actually back, and how the Fantastic Four and X-Men are being folded into this next chapter of the MCU.Marvel Studios and the Russo Brothers clearly came to Comic Con ready to blow the roof off, and this Special Look proves Avengers: Doomsday is shaping up to be the biggest crossover event yet — bigger than Avengers 5 rumors even hinted at. Doom is coming, and after this teaser, we're more locked in than ever.If you love trailer reaction content, marvel reaction videos, and honest first time watching breakdowns, this is exactly what you're here for. Let us know in the comments — are you Team Doom or Team Avengers?🎬 Don't forget to LIKE, COMMENT, and SUBSCRIBE for more reactions to all things Marvel!#AvengersDoomsday #DoctorDoom #MCU #MarvelStudios #TrailerReaction

snippet.description:
Lots of things have been happening on Hermitcraft, so I decided to focus an episode on some of these fun side quests.

Today we finish up a few loose projects around the base. We get invited by Xisuma to make a little music loop on his awesome new redstone machine. We enter into Scar's storage wars contest with a nostalgic submission. We see the redstone calling to add a diamond deposit system for the bank. EGG summons us to the new Chicago EGG Diner for a meeting about our new pranking business.

snippet.title: Avengers Doomsday Special Look Reaction | D23 Expo
snippet.description:
OH MY GOD MORE FOOTAGE FOR AVENGERS DOOMSDAY! HERE IS MY REACTION 
What happens when Marvel gives us another look at Avengers: Doomsday—and FINALLY lets us see even more of Doctor Doom?!

The new Avengers: Doomsday Special Look is here around D23, and somehow my excitement for this movie just keeps getting BIGGER.

In my Avengers: Doomsday Special Look reaction, I’m diving into the new footage, the additional looks at Doctor Doom, and everything that continues making this feel like the massive Marvel event I’ve been waiting for.

Because at this point?

I JUST WANT MORE DOOM.

Robert Downey Jr. returning to the MCU as Victor Von Doom remains one of the biggest swings Marvel has ever taken.

And every new look at this character has me even more curious about what the Russos are cooking.

I don’t want Tony Stark 2.0.

I want DOCTOR DOOM.

Give me the intelligence.

Give me the arrogance.

Give me the terrifying presence.

Give me the ruler.

Give me someone who walks into a room filled with Avengers, Fantastic Four members, X-Men, Wakandans and every other hero in this movie and somehow STILL feels like the most powerful person standing there.

Because the scale of Doomsday is already ridiculous.

Marvel is bringing together heroes from across the MCU and beyond, including the Avengers, Fantastic Four and returning X-Men characters, all against Doctor Doom.

And D23 is only adding to the Doom hype.

Marvel’s D23 presentation has also given fans another look at Doom’s costuming, including a second Doctor Doom suit, while the TVA-themed experience includes imagery involving a damaged TVA and destroyed Sentinel.

WHAT IS HAPPENING IN THIS MOVIE?!

That is what has me so excited.

This feels BIG.

Not simply because there are a ton of characters.

It feels like Marvel is positioning Doctor Doom as an existential threat to EVERYTHING.

And with Secret Wars coming after this, I’m watching every frame trying to figure out where all of this is going.

How does Doom connect to the multiverse?

What does he want?

Why are all of these different universes colliding?

What happens when Doom meets the Avengers?

The Fantastic Four?

The X-Men?

And what exactly is Marvel still hiding from us?

That is what I want an Avengers movie to feel like.

An EVENT where every new piece of footage gives us answers while somehow creating ten more questions.

In this Avengers: Doomsday Special Look reaction and Marvel commentary, I discuss the new Doctor Doom footage, Robert Downey Jr. as Victor Von Doom, the D23 reveals, the Avengers, Fantastic Four, X-Men, the multiverse, and why my hype for Doomsday is officially through the roof.

Are you sold on Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom yet?!

Make sure to LIKE, SUBSCRIBE, and SHARE for more Avengers: Doomsday reactions, Marvel trailer reactions, Doctor Doom theories, MCU discussions, and movie commentary.

Avengers: Doomsday arrives December 18, 2026.

snippet.title: Battlefield 6 x Top Gun: Carrier Strike Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Top Gun in Season 4 for free starting August 18.

Take to the skies and become the best of the best. The Top Gun update arrives in Battlefield 6 on August 18, bringing high-speed aerial combat, legendary battlefields, and new ways to dominate the Pacific.

Pilot the new F/A-81F Super Spectre and F-74A Seacat two-seat fighter jets with your wingman, master intense dogfights in Gauntlet: Fighter Sweep, and fight across land, sea, and air in the reimagined Carrier Strike. Return to the iconic Wake Island, rebuilt for Battlefield 6 with large-scale combined-arms combat across its beaches, bunkers, and surrounding waters.

Complete event challenges to earn Top Gun-themed rewards and unlock the Interdictor, Battlefield 6's longest-range sniper rifle, through the Battle Pass.

The update also expands Tsuru Reef with playable aircraft carriers, bringing the reimagined Carrier Strike experience to Battlefield's biggest map yet.

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community.  Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: C9 vs FX - VCT Americas Stage 2 Play-Ins - Day 2
snippet.description:
Widely regarded as the most successful region in international VALORANT competition, VCT Americas is home to world-class talent, championship-winning veterans, and the latest generation of emerging stars. The region also boasts the reigning Masters London champions and the current VALORANT Champions winners.
Now, the stakes are higher than ever. Every team enters Stage 2 with one objective: secure a spot at VALORANT Champions Shanghai.
Leviatán enters Stage 2 riding high after its Masters London triumph. NRG is ready to remind the world why it has long been considered a global powerhouse. Meanwhile, G2 Esports aims to defend its VCT Americas crown and add another championship to its trophy case.
We’re proud to work with our fantastic partners throughout 2026: ExpressVPN, HP, Pulsar, Red Bull, Samsung, Secretlab, Verizon, and Zowie.

Follow the below channels to get the latest information on VCT Americas:
Twitter/X: https://www.x.com/valesportsna

snippet.title: When the Desert Fox Hunted Desert Rats
snippet.description:
Follow and Wishlist our game on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606970?utm_source=0245

May 27th, 1942. General Erwin Rommel leads hundreds of Panzers and ten thousand vehicles of the Afrika Korps charging across the Libyan Desert, around the flank of the British-held Gazala Line, aiming for the vital Allied port of Tobruk. Spearheading the attack of the 15th Panzer Division is a veteran Panzer commander, Capt. Johannes ‘The Lion of Capuzzo’ Kümmel in his Panzer III Ausf. J. Driving northward, his Panzers run straight into the Desert Rats of the British 7th Armored Division. The British M3 Stuart light tanks, led by Lt. Bill Close of the 3rd Royal Tank Regiment, are no match for the formidable Panzers. But the Allies have a trick up their sleeve - the brand new American-made M3 Grant tanks, which the Germans have never fought before. In a titanic battle under the scorching Sun, the desert becomes a tank graveyard with heavy losses on both sides. But the ‘Desert Fox’ Rommel outfoxes the British and emerges victorious.

Sources:

Close, Bill (2013). Tank Commander: From the Fall of France to the Defeat of Germany – The Memoirs of Bill Close.
Forczyk, Robert (2023). Desert Armour: Tank Warfare in North Africa: Gazala to Tunisia, 1942–43.
Ford, Ken and White, John (2008). Gazala 1942: Rommel’s Greatest Victory.
Forty, George (1997). The Armies of Rommel.
Forty, George (2003). 7th Armoured Division: The 'Desert Rats'.
Jörgensen, Christer (2015). Rommel’s High Tide: Gazala 1942.
Liddell Hart, B. H., editor (1953). The Rommel Papers.
Pimlott, John, editor (2014). Rommel: In His Own Words.
